about.title: About me
about.intro: I see myself as a mathematically minded artist with a love of detail – a true character.

location.text: You will find me on rugged shores, where so many legends originate. I grew up on the Darß and later moved to Rostock to gain life experience, continuing to shape my own path along the way.

thinking.text: Logical thinking and questioning reality at every opportunity have been among my constant companions for as long as I can remember. My education began at Freie Schule Prerow and continued through year 11. After that, I spent 15 eventful years in hospitality before the desire for freedom led me here to pursue my own path.

interests.text: From relaxed gaming to fire shows, animals, nature, and sport run through my life like a common thread, alongside an appreciation of food and culture.

skills.title: My skills
skills.intro: I develop modern web applications across the full stack, using technologies that enable performant, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

cta.text: I am constantly learning and look forward to new challenges. Feel free to get in touch and tell me about your project.

server_logs.title: 3. Server logs
server_logs.text: The following data in particular may be processed in server logs whenever a page is accessed:

data.ip: IP address of the accessing device
data.request: Date and time, requested file or URL, and amount of data transferred
data.referrer: Referrer URL, if transmitted by the browser
data.browser: Browser type, browser version, and operating system

server_logs.purpose_basis: The processing serves to provide the website technically and to identify and prevent disruptions and attacks. Article 6(1)(f) GDPR may serve as the legal basis. The legitimate interest lies in operating the website securely and reliably. The actual logging and retention period depend on the hosting provider that still needs to be specified.

email_contact.title: 4. Contact form and email delivery
email_contact.transport: When the contact form is submitted, the name, email address, and message are transmitted to a dedicated backend endpoint. The backend validates the entries and forwards the message as a plaintext email to florianweimann9@gmail.com.
email_contact.processing: The application does not store form data in its own database and does not log message content. The IP address is processed temporarily for technical rate limiting. A honeypot field is used for automated spam detection. The data is processed in order to respond to the enquiry. Depending on its content, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR for pre-contractual communication or Article 6(1)(f) GDPR for other enquiries may serve as the legal basis.
email_contact.provider: Email delivery is configured through Gmail SMTP. Google processes the data required for delivery; the received message is processed and stored in the recipient Gmail mailbox.
email_contact.retention_todo: [TODO: Before production use, verify and document Google's specific processing, possible international data transfers, contractual basis, and retention period in the Gmail mailbox]

language_storage.title: 5. Language selection in the browser
language_storage.text: When switching actively between German and English, the website stores the selection exclusively in the browser's local storage. This retains the selected language for a later visit. The information is not transmitted to the web server.
language_storage.legal_note: Storage only takes place after the user selects a language. Whether it qualifies as strictly necessary storage under Section 25(2) TDDDG in the specific deployment should receive a final legal review before publication. The entry can be deleted at any time using the browser settings.

cookies_analytics.title: 6. Cookies and analytics
cookies_analytics.text: In its currently implemented state, this portfolio does not set cookies and does not use analytics, tracking, or advertising services. CLI telemetry present in the Angular development environment is not part of the deployed website.

fonts.title: 7. Fonts
fonts.text: The Figtree font is served locally by this website. Loading the font does not establish a connection to Google Fonts or any other external font provider.

external_links.title: 8. External links
external_links.text: This website contains links to external services, in particular GitHub and LinkedIn, as well as published project demos. A connection to the respective third party is only established when such a link is opened. From that point on, the privacy terms of the respective provider apply.
